config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licensee/register entry, including its licence, register-entry label, supplied ABN or ACN, licence start date, optional pre-FSR information, principal business address components, and licence conditions.

fields.evidence: Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN. Discovery row 2 header/sample: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN=85007186003. The abn operation validates the ABN and emits no value for a valid ACN.

Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN. Discovery row 2 header/sample: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN=85007186003. The acn operation validates the ACN and emits no value for a valid ABN; no ABN suffix inference is used.
Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality of the current principal business address. Discovery row 2 sample: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL=SOUTHBANK.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state of the current principal business address. Discovery row 2 sample: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE=VIC.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode of the current principal business address. Discovery row 2 sample: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE=3006. Values are preserved as strings and are not zero-padded.

unmapped_fields.reason: Identifies the source register, not an ontology legal entity, trading name, licence identifier, status, or other canonical field. Help File p.8 data dictionary describes it as the register name.

Unique AFS licence number, but the ontology has no licence-number field; it must not be placed in an entity identifier field. Help File p.8 describes it as the unique number allocated to the AFS licensee.

Retained as the raw subject_label_field, but not mapped canonically: Help File p.8 calls it the register entry name, and does not establish it as a legal or trading name. Discovery row 2 sample is IPIB PTY LTD.

Licence start/issue date, not company registration date. Help File p.8 identifies it as the start date of the AFS licensee; the ontology has no licence-date field, so it must not map to entity.date_registered.
Superseded pre-FSR register identifiers and licence numbers, with nested tilde/comma-delimited content. Help File p.9 describes this field; the ontology has no prior-licence field.

Not mapped because Help File p.10 states that countries outside Australia are represented by the sentinel value "International", which is not a country value. Mapping the field directly would create semantically invalid address.country observations; raw values remain unmapped.

Current financial services and products authorised under the licence, including nested tilde-delimited condition text. Help File p.11 describes this field; the ontology has no licence-condition or authorisation field.

limitations: The source is a current-register point-in-time snapshot of current Australian Financial Services licensees (Help File p.3); this does not establish entity.status=active, deregistration, liquidation, branch structure, trading names, or reporting groups.
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is a mixed supplied ABN-or-ACN field. It is mapped to both validators; each emits only its applicable checksum-valid identifier, with no suffix-derived ACN.
The principal business address components are mapped as business address data, not a registered office, service location, or branch address.

AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is deliberately unmapped because the source sentinel International is not a canonical country value; an Australian value such as the discovery sample Australia is therefore not mapped either under this conservative rule.
AFS_LIC_NAME is retained only as a raw subject label and is not asserted to be a legal or trading name.

No record-level observation timestamp or source-native row key is present in the supplied columns. Use the supplied publication_proxy as observed_at and a deterministic traceable source-record identifier based on the raw row/snapshot locator in the observation envelope.
The source envelope supplies publication timestamp, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia licence, and ingestion metadata; these must be attached by the extraction system.
All authority and field-confidence scores are provisional judgements and require human review.
